blocks.text: Seven impact indicators, twenty-eight outcome indicators and thirty-seven output indicators measure the plan, each with a definition, a source, an owner and a frequency.

Tier 1 measures the 2035 case and is reported to the Board. Tier 2 measures the focus areas, one to three each, and is reported to Steerco each quarter where the source allows. Tier 3 measures the initiatives' own outputs and is reported by the leads to the programme office each month. The full register, with targets, sits in the toolkit (section 5.7).

blocks.message: Twenty-eight Tier 2 indicators give each focus area one to three outcome measures, and nine of them have no baseline yet.

blocks.text: The nine without a baseline are T2-04, T2-18, T2-20, T2-21, T2-23, T2-24, T2-25, T2-26 and T2-28. Each carries no target until its baseline exists, on the dates in the data gaps table (section 5.4).
